report.summary: 4 surviving findings: confirm_task in-place mutation contract (critical), _paths_overlap isolation gap (medium), _walk parent-tuple assumption (medium), guard_measurement_match node-set mismatch (high). Proposed steps for each.
risks: confirm_task in-place mutation assumption: if changed to return new dict, minting breaks silently.
_paths_overlap only checks declared paths: no OS-level isolation found, concurrent writes may conflict.
_walk self-in-parent: any caller relying on parent tuples may misbehave.
guard_measurement_match node-set mismatch: may reject valid results or miss invalid ones.
todos: Check for OS-level isolation (worktree, container) for write conflicts.
Identify all callers of _walk in switches.py and verify parent-tuple handling.
Write test for guard_measurement_match node-set completeness.

items.title: Enforce confirm_task mutation contract in daedalus/eval/mint.py
items.why_now: Critical: if confirm_task is changed to return a new dict, minting loses mutations silently. No enforcement exists.

steps.do: Add type annotation and assert that confirm_task mutates the passed dict (e.g., check a known key is set after call).
Update confirm_minted_task to not rely on in-place mutation: capture return value and use it.

items.assumption: confirm_task currently mutates in-place; we will inspect implementation to confirm.

items.title: Add OS-level isolation check for concurrent writes in daedalus/kairos/scheduler.py
items.why_now: Medium: _paths_overlap only checks declared paths; if no OS isolation, writes may conflict. Docstring already warns, but we should verify isolation exists.

steps.do: Search for worktree/container isolation in scheduler.py or related modules (e.g., worktree.py, containment.py). If none found, add a check in _paths_overlap that logs a warning if isolation is absent.

items.assumption: Isolation mechanism may exist elsewhere; we will search the codebase.

items.title: Audit all callers of _walk in daedalus/mapping/switches.py for self-in-parent handling
items.why_now: Medium: _walk includes self in parent tuple; callers relying on parent tuples may misbehave. Need to verify each caller handles correctly.

steps.do: Identify all callers of _walk in switches.py (grep for '_walk('). For each, verify they handle self-inclusion in parent tuple.
steps.verified_by: Static analysis: grep output shows callers; manual review confirms correctness.

steps.do: Add a comment in _walk docstring noting self-inclusion.

items.assumption: All callers are in switches.py; no external callers.

items.title: Add test for guard_measurement_match node-set completeness
items.why_now: High: guard_measurement_match may reject valid results if reach.py visits nodes outside selection, or miss nodes if markdown.py deferred links not in selection. Need test to verify.

steps.do: Write a test that creates a selection with known nodes, runs reach.analyse on a repo with weak edges, and checks if observed node set matches selection.
Write a test that checks if nodes referenced only via deferred links in markdown.py appear in selection.

items.assumption: We can construct a repo with weak edges and deferred links; may need to use test fixtures.
